raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
- `build.sh`: an untrusted base build computes the image keys of its merge base with main, and for each image whose key is main's it waits for main's CI build to push it instead of building the same image in parallel
- `build.sh`: a trusted base build marks the image it is building (`rocm/vllm-ci:building-<tag>`, refreshed every 5 minutes); others wait only while that mark is fresh, with a 10-minute start grace spent once per build
- `build.sh`: a branch that changes an image's inputs still builds it at once; trusted builds never wait, and if main cannot be read nothing waits
- `test_rocm_build.py`: waiting and reusing main's images, building at once when main is not building them, the once-per-build grace, registry errors while waiting, and the heartbeat not holding up the build

When a ROCm base image key changes on main, every PR base build that starts before main's base build finishes misses the trusted image and rebuilds the same stack in its own `pr<N>-` namespace, so the amd-cpu queue fills with identical builds that take hours each; on 2026-10-27 about 30 `refresh-rocm-base-amd` jobs were rebuilding the same base at once. A failed or canceled main build stops refreshing its mark, so builds waiting on it notice within 15 minutes and build the image themselves. The 300-minute deadline on all waits is only a backstop for a hung main build or a planted mark (PR hosts can still push to `rocm/vllm-ci` until the PR-host split), and a stack built after it may not fit the step's 540-minute timeout. Nightlies and branch builds wait too, and #64131 also edits `ensure()`, so whichever of the two merges second needs a small rebase. Follow-up to #61939; `pytest tests/tools/test_rocm_build.py` passes 38 tests (17 new) in 10 runs out of 10, and HEAD's image keys are unchanged from main's.

AI assistance (Claude Code) was used to draft this change. Every line was reviewed by the submitter.

+read -r Ks Kr <<<"$keys"

+# heartbeat <tag>  — mark <tag> as being built: push $TRUSTED:building-<tag>, a label-only image
+#   holding the current time. Best effort: a missed beat only makes waiting builds build it too.
+HEARTBEAT_LABEL=ai.vllm.rocm.heartbeat
+heartbeat() {
+  printf 'FROM scratch\nLABEL %s=%s\n' "$HEARTBEAT_LABEL" "$(date +%s)" \
+    | docker buildx build -q --provenance=false --output "type=registry,name=$TRUSTED:building-$1" - \
+      >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+}
+
+# wait_for_trusted <tag> [<sibling-suffix>]
+#   Poll the trusted registry for <tag>; print its pinned ref(s) as ensure() does, or return 1 to
+#   build it here. Waits only while main's build of <tag> is alive: its heartbeat is at most
+#   ROCM_HEARTBEAT_STALE_MINUTES (default 15) old. Without one, it gives main's build
+#   ROCM_TRUSTED_START_GRACE_MINUTES (default 10) to start, once per build: after a wait finds
+#   main not building, later images get no grace. ROCM_TRUSTED_WAIT_MINUTES (default 300) bounds
+#   all waits of a build together. It is reached only while main's mark stays fresh (a hung build,
+#   or a planted mark), and a stack built after it may not fit the step's 540-min timeout.
+WAIT_UNTIL=$(( $(date +%s) + ${ROCM_TRUSTED_WAIT_MINUTES:-300} * 60 ))
+NO_MAIN_BUILD=$(mktemp -u)   # a file, not a variable: each ensure() runs in its own subshell
+trap 'rm -f "$NO_MAIN_BUILD"' EXIT
+wait_for_trusted() {
+  local tag=$1 sibling=${2:-} ref=$TRUSTED:$1 d ds rc beat now start
+  local stale=$(( ${ROCM_HEARTBEAT_STALE_MINUTES:-15} * 60 ))
+  local grace=$(( ${ROCM_TRUSTED_START_GRACE_MINUTES:-10} * 60 ))
+  [[ ! -e $NO_MAIN_BUILD ]] || grace=0
+  start=$(date +%s)
+  echo "--- :hourglass: $tag is main's; waiting for main's build to push $ref" >&2
+  while (( $(date +%s) < WAIT_UNTIL )); do
+    if d=$(digest "$ref") && { [[ -z $sibling ]] || ds=$(digest "$ref$sibling"); }; then
+      echo "Main's build pushed $ref@$d" >&2
+      echo "$ref@$d${sibling:+ $ref$sibling@$ds}"
+      return 0
+    else
+      rc=$?; ((rc == 1)) || return $rc
+    fi
+    now=$(date +%s)
+    beat=$(label "$TRUSTED:building-$tag" "$HEARTBEAT_LABEL" 2>/dev/null) || beat=""
+    if ! { [[ $beat =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && (( now - beat <= stale )); } && (( now - start >= grace )); then
+      echo "No build of $ref in progress (no heartbeat in the last $((stale / 60)) min); building it here" >&2
+      : >"$NO_MAIN_BUILD"
+      return 1
+    fi
+    sleep "${ROCM_TRUSTED_POLL_SECONDS:-120}"
+  done
+  echo "$ref did not appear in time; building it here" >&2
+  return 1

+    assert not built_tags(calls, stderr)
+
+
+def test_a_registry_error_while_waiting_fails_the_step_without_building(tmp_path):
+    status, stderr, calls = untrusted_base(
+        tmp_path,
+        APPEARS="rocm/vllm-ci:",
+        BEAT_AGE="60",
+        FAILURE="appear",
+        ROCM_TRUSTED_WAIT_MINUTES="5",
+    )
+    assert status == 75, stderr
+    assert not built_tags(calls, stderr)
+
+
+def test_trusted_builds_mark_what_they_build(tmp_path):
+    status, stderr, calls = run_build(tmp_path, "base")
+    assert status == 0, stderr
+    beats = [c.split()[1] for c in calls if c.startswith("heartbeat ")]
+    assert {b.split(":", 1)[1].rsplit("-", 1)[0] for b in beats} == {
+        "building-stack-rocm",
+        "building-runtime-rocm",
+        "building-test-deps-rocm",
+    }
+    assert all(b.startswith("rocm/vllm-ci:building-") for b in beats)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("mode", "repo"),
+    [
+        ("base", "rocm/vllm-dev"),
+        ("release", "ecr/release"),
+        ("release-base", "ecr/release"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_only_trusted_base_builds_mark(tmp_path, mode, repo):
+    status, stderr, calls = run_build(
+        tmp_path,
+        mode,
+        ROCM_CI_REPO=repo,
+        BUILDKITE_PULL_REQUEST="7",
+        CHANGED="docker/Dockerfile.rocm_base",
+    )
+    assert status == 0, stderr
+    assert built_tags(calls, stderr)
+    assert not any(c.startswith("heartbeat ") for c in calls)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("failure", ["fetch-main", "merge-base"])
+def test_a_pr_that_cannot_read_main_builds_without_waiting(tmp_path, failure):
+    status, stderr, calls = untrusted_base(
+        tmp_path, FAILURE=failure, BEAT_AGE="60", ROCM_TRUSTED_WAIT_MINUTES="5"
+    )
+    assert status == 0, stderr
+    assert "waiting for main's build" not in stderr
+    assert len(built_tags(calls, stderr)) == 3
+
+
+def test_a_pr_gives_main_the_start_grace_once_per_build(tmp_path):
+    # Main is not building: after the stack's grace, the runtime and test-deps
+    # build without waiting again.
+    status, stderr, calls = untrusted_base(
+        tmp_path,
+        FAKE_CLOCK=str(tmp_path / "clock"),
+        ROCM_TRUSTED_START_GRACE_MINUTES="5",
+        ROCM_TRUSTED_WAIT_MINUTES="300",
+    )
+    assert status == 0, stderr
+    polls = [c.split(":building-")[1].rsplit("-", 1)[0] for c in calls if "beat?" in c]
+    assert polls.count("stack-rocm") > 1
+    assert polls.count("runtime-rocm") == polls.count("test-deps-rocm") == 1
+    assert len(built_tags(calls, stderr)) == 3
+
+
+def test_the_heartbeat_does_not_hold_up_the_build(tmp_path):
+    # The refresh loop must neither keep $(ensure ...) open nor outlive the bake.
+    start = time.monotonic()
+    status, stderr, _ = run_build(
+        tmp_path, "base", REAL_SLEEP="1", ROCM_HEARTBEAT_SECONDS="20"
+    )
+    assert status == 0, stderr
+    assert time.monotonic() - start < 15
